ownership.instructions: The Pulse candidate completed and pinned every mapping, generation, and projection decision in the same candidate Git commit as mapper.py.

leaf_contract.basis: Sorted JSON Pointer paths for every primitive leaf in valid-base-sepolia-01 from frozen Pulse fixtures/v0.3/cases.json; UTF-8 compact JSON array SHA-256.

prohibited_sources.reason: Expected outcomes, reason codes, checks, and execution gates must not drive the Pulse result.
The committed VATE admission receipt is a comparison-only artifact and must not be copied into the Pulse input or result projection.

pulse_profile.boundary: Frozen Pulse v0.3 schema literals only; not VATE source pins.

asset_profile.boundary: Candidate must choose synthetic offline values and an exact decimal conversion without implying price, production-token status, or VATE provenance.

evm_participants.boundary: Public fixture identities only. Merchant maps to Pulse payee identity and never implicitly to pay_to.

ap2_generation_profile.payment_id_transform: payment- plus first 20 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256(transaction_id)
ap2_generation_profile.psp_confirmation_id_transform: psp- plus first 20 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256(transaction_id)

fixture_key_handling.candidate_source: Python standard-library SHA-256 or Keccak public-label-to-scalar derivation with RFC 6979 signatures; persist only public labels, public JWKs, the public EVM address, and signatures.
fixture_key_handling.required_record: Record deterministic public fixture-key labels, public JWKs or public EVM address, and signatures. Persist no private key, seed, mnemonic, or other non-public signing material.

pulse_expected_envelope.boundary: Schema-only neutral Pulse field. verifyConformanceCase does not use it to produce ConformanceReport. It must not derive from VATE expected data.

Exact copy solely to satisfy Pulse ConformanceCaseSchema. Call verifyConformanceCase directly; never use this field to derive or normalize the raw Pulse report.
Preserve byte-for-byte raw output and record its raw SHA-256 before any projection. No expected lookup, case-ID verdict table, or post-hoc change is allowed.

Project allow only when the eligible source is within its mandate and the raw Pulse report is consistent with no failures. Preserve an exact AP2_X402_AMOUNT_MISMATCH as deny plus non-attenuate/mismatch. Project a stale source with EIP3009_VALID_BEFORE_EXPIRED as deny plus reject/match. Use only eligible inputs and the raw Pulse report.
Set true only for the consistent no-failure allow projection; set false for the exact amount mismatch, expiry rejection, and every unsupported raw report.

Emit EVIDENCE_VERIFIED and POLICY_MATCH for consistent allow; preserve AP2_X402_AMOUNT_MISMATCH verbatim for overrun; emit PERMIT_EXPIRED and FAIL_CLOSED only when the raw stale report includes EIP3009_VALID_BEFORE_EXPIRED.

For consistent allow emit decision.outcome, request.audience, evidence[0].protocol_hint, and evidence.verification.result. Emit no checks for overrun. For stale expiry emit decision.outcome and evidence.verification.failure_reason. Every emitted check passes from eligible-input or raw-report evidence.

completion_requirements: Resolve every candidate decision and every null scaffolding value in a candidate-owned completed worksheet at an exact commit.
Retain exactly the frozen 142 primitive Pulse input leaves and the required empty /expected/failureCodes container; do not add, omit, or collapse leaf records.
For every leaf retain source_document, source_json_pointer, dependencies, exact transform, Pulse destination, provenance, and ownership.

Classify provenance by direct value origin: direct copies or deterministic transforms of eligible VATE bytes are vate-derived; candidate-selected or candidate-generated direct origins are non-vate-scaffolding, with transitive VATE influence disclosed through dependencies, generator records, and sensitivity replay.
Keep all VATE /expected pointers and all VATE admission-receipt bytes out of mapping_rows, generated_field_inventory, the Pulse input, and result projection.
Regenerate AP2 JOSE/SD-JWT, x402, EIP-3009, Payment Receipt, public-key, and signature fields after applying VATE-derived values; an unchanged Pulse fixture plus sidecar VATE hashes is invalid.
Call frozen verifyConformanceCase without semantic changes and preserve its exact report objects in raw JSON before projection.
Record pre/post raw SHA-256 for every Pulse input, the raw output hash, mapping source hash, worksheet hash, and starter manifest hash.
Preserve VATE attenuate versus Pulse reject/non-attenuate as an explicit mismatch; never normalize it to pass.

Use the standard candidate executable interface with opaque workItemId values and eligible admissionRequest/ap2Mandate JSON only; the candidate runtime must never receive a VATE case, case ID, /expected subtree, admission receipt, or post-execution receipt.

Bind the canonical map request, byte-exact candidate map stdout, completed worksheet, generated records, Pulse input, raw Pulse replay, canonical projection request, and byte-exact projection stdout in one bundle-local hash chain.
Pass independent recomputation and randomized amount, merchant, evaluation-time/window, and replay-nonce sensitivity probes; this is reproducible execution evidence, not a tamper-proof proof.
